subject: Emotions
title: Nostalgia's Warm Glow
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on Nostalgia's Warm Glow.

hook.text: A song from high school plays and suddenly you're 17 again—warm, safe, and slightly sad. That's nostalgia.

buildup.text: Nostalgia was once diagnosed as a disease. Swiss doctors in the 1600s treated homesick soldiers for it.

discovery.text: Modern research shows nostalgia is psychologically healthy. It increases self-esteem, social bonds, and meaning.

twist.text: Nostalgia is bittersweet by design. The sadness makes the joy sharper. Pure happiness doesn't create the same warmth.

climax.text: Lonely people are more nostalgic. The brain uses happy memories as a substitute for missing social connection.

punchline.text: Nostalgia is joy borrowed from your past self.
